title: Oyo Alongolami na Momekano ya Mai
intro: Na mikanda ya kala ya makomi ya kala, ezali na moto moko ya kobenda likebi oyo lisolo na ye ebandi te na likamwisi ya kokamwa to emoniseli ya nkake, kasi na komekama ya pete kasi ya mozindo ya bondimi. Ekolo moko etelemaki na esika ya bokutani, kolukaka bokambi ya bonzambe mpo na bokambi. Oyo esalemaki ezalaki momekano ya mayele mpenza na boye ete elingaki komonisa bandimi ya solo kati na bango. Okoki ko découvrir mystère oyo na ba indices oyo batiki?
clues: Nawutaki na molɔngɔ oyo bato bazalaki kosepela na yango, mpe Allah aponaki ngai mpo na ntina mosantu oyo bakokaki kososola te.
Nzoto na ngai ememaki elembo ya bokeseni oyo basusu bazalaki na yango te, kosala ete natelema mosika na kati ya bato na ngai.
Ntango ebale esakolamaki lokola momekano, mingi bazongaki nsima —kasi napusanaki liboso, kopusama na bondimi ya kotengatenga te na elaka ya Allah.
Napesamaki mitindo ete namela ata moke te na mai oyo epekisami, nzokande litangá moko ekimaki na mbɛbu na ngai​—lisumu oyo ezalaki kotungisa motema na ngai mpo na libela.
Allah atyaki ngai destiné na kokutana na elenge mobateli mpate oyo mokolo mosusu akokoma lisapo mpo abomaki monguna moko ya nguya.
Ntango mampinga mabundaki, nakweyaki na loboko ya monguna te, kasi na mobeko ya bonzambe lokola etumbu mpo na kozanga botosi na ngai na ebale.

outcome.answer: Nakweyaki na etumba lokola etumbu mpo na likambo moko na ngai ya kozanga botosi

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
